existing_brief_context: TikTok-first strategy: the whole creative approach is to be designed primarily for TikTok (RFP).
The brand guidelines apply: the RFP says the attached guidelines are in force, and the client's email confirms version 3.1 is the valid one. Which rules are binding for this brief is not stated.
The product name Meltemi Fizz is always written in Latin script, in full — never transliterated, never abbreviated to "Fizz" (brand guidelines v3.1).
Logo clear space: minimum 1× the height of the wordmark on all sides (brand guidelines v3.1).
Primary palette: Aegean Blue #1B4F8A, Citrus Yellow #F5C518 (brand guidelines v3.1).
Backgrounds must not use gradients over photography (brand guidelines v3.1).
Permitted claims: "zero sugar" and "φυσικά συστατικά", the latter per the approved ingredient list (brand guidelines v3.1; the list itself is not included).
Not permitted: any health or weight-loss claim (brand guidelines v3.1).
Not permitted: any comparison naming a competitor brand (brand guidelines v3.1).
No alcohol association of any kind — imagery, occasions, co-branding (brand guidelines v3.1).
Avoid generic "beach party" clichés; the brand leans premium-everyday, not spring break (brand guidelines v3.1, phrased as "avoid").
Tone guidance: confident, modern Greek with natural use of English category terms; humor allowed, sarcasm about competitors is not (brand guidelines v3.1, marked as guidance).
The key visual (heard as «κι βίζουαλ»; proposed match "key visual", unconfirmed) must shout summer, but a premium summer. "Premium summer" is not defined.
